Caesium is a Group I element.
Which statement describes a property of caesium?
A
It does not conduct electricity.
B
It has a higher melting point than sodium.
C
It reacts more vigorously with water than potassium.
D
It is less dense than lithium.

options.label: B
options.text: It has a higher melting point than sodium.

options.label: C
options.text: It reacts more vigorously with water than potassium.

options.label: D
options.text: It is less dense than lithium.
